title: Time-iteration methods for controllability
summary: These notes are based on a short course delivered at the Summer School EUR MINT 2025 "Control, Inverse Problems and Spectral Theory", held in June 2025 in Toulouse, France. The course presents three important strategies in control theory, formulated as time-iteration methods, where each time step brings the state of the system closer to the desired target. For linear PDEs, we survey the classical Lebeau-Robbiano method and its more recent developments.
